_comment: PRIMARY DEMO TEMPLATE. Empathetic approval email. Note the tone-specific opening — an EMPATHETIC template must acknowledge the problem before delivering the good news.
subject: Sorted: your {{productName}} replacement is on the way
bodyTemplate:
Hi {{firstName}},

I'm sorry your {{productName}} arrived damaged — that's not the experience we want you to have.

Here's what we've done:
{{resolutionSummary}}

{{dropOffInstructions}}

Your tracking number is {{trackingNumber}}. You'll hear from us at every step, so there's nothing more you need to do.

— The Cosmic Mart team

_comment: DENIAL TEMPLATE. Cosmic Mart is criticized for unresponsiveness, so a denial must still explain the reason, cite the policy and offer a route forward.
